newsitem.title: USA: Pudgie's Chicken in pact with creditors.
newsitem.headline: Pudgie's Chicken in pact with creditors.

text.p: Pudgie's Chicken Inc said Friday that the Bankruptcy Court overseeing its Chapter 11 case approved an agreement among Pudgie's, its secured creditor, and its official creditors and equity security holders committees.

Under the agreement, which the company said was reached Feb 12, the secured creditor agreed to a plan of reorganization that pays the secured creditor $1 million on its $3.6 million claim and provides the secured creditor with a proportionate share of any stock given to unsecured creditors in satisfaction of the balance of its claim.

The agreement also allows Pudgie's to obtain further debtor-in-possession financing senior to the secured lender's claim, to use the secured creditor's cash collateral, and to release all franchise fees previously held in escrow.
In exchange, the company and the official committees agreed to recognize the validity of the secured creditor's claim and end all litigation relative to that claim.

The company described the agreement as an important milestone for Pudgie's reorganization which will allow it to discuss proposals by potential third parties who are interested in making investments in Pudgie's.
The company has said it has been soliciting third parties interested in providing interim financing and long-term equity investments.
Pudgie's, an operator of takeout and delivery restaurants, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on Sept 18.
